proven.claim: Candidate-feature owner-process CUDA residency exists with checksum validation, CandidateOrdinal gather, lease release, and no CUDA IPC or identity authority
PyTorch semantic-vector reference already performs L2 normalization plus bounded dot-product/cosine top-k on a resident CUDA tile
ACE utility ranking has been exercised against real GPU LRU pressure and the ordering footgun was fixed with promote_ranked()
Generic artifact addresses already support GPU_RESIDENT locators and candidate-feature batch requests bind exact lease/device/buffer/checksum identity

duplicationFindings.preferredConsolidationDirection: Keep the residency-v1 family as the candidate-feature lease seam because CandidateFeatureGpuBatchRequestV1 already depends on it and it maps the real Python residency observation into ArtifactAddressV1; archive or explicitly supersede the unused resident-lease-v1 family only after caller census remains empty.
Do not add AtlasNumericArtifactV1 yet. First define which existing contract owns immutable numeric artifact lineage and which contract is only a storage/location projection.

gaps.detail: The generic tensor-residency subsystem remains isolated from production request paths; proven GPU mechanisms are not equivalent to a live pipeline owner.
TensorRuntime.ensureGpu() checks presence by tileKey only and does not verify expected artifact checksum/revision before reuse.
ResidencyEvent and Valkey invalidation interfaces exist, but no live revision-change proof currently demonstrates deterministic GPU demotion/eviction plus an auditable receipt.
NumericBackendDescriptor exists but has no callers and does not yet bind provider kind plus provider/runtime revision to a proven execution receipt.
Do not implement until artifact/lease ownership and revision invalidation are canonicalized.
Keep as a separate challenger kernel implementation; do not mix SIMT and cuTile code inside one kernel.
Record provider/version and behavior rather than freezing a concrete RMM memory-resource class ABI.

doNotDoYet: Do not add a new AtlasNumericArtifactV1 beside the existing artifact manifests.
Do not add a third GPU residency lease owner.
Do not install or promote cuTile solely to prove feasibility.
Do not add a custom allocator or freeze RMM concrete class names.
Do not begin PageRank or CAGRA from this gate.
